title: The board fits a phone with live content: the gauges' source named as a link, columns that shrink, pickers capped
why: Jason's screenshot (2026-11-23, 'Control: layout issue'): the board scrolled sideways on his phone. With the live alarms on the bench: the first view (Is it delivering?) was 468px at 390 because the gauges' source line printed GitHub's raw address as one unbreakable word and the view's grid column took its width; Maintenance (396px) and Reports' picker (379px at 360) the same way. Now the source line names its file as a link, each view's column is minmax(0,1fr), notes wrap long words, and the pickers and labels shrink (decisions/0058 §11: nothing scrolls sideways).
